planning_note: Leaf stateful module that generates AES round constants via a 4-bit synchronous counter and registered 32-bit output. Structured around counter control, GF(2^8) derived lookup, and output registration.

structural_blocks.purpose: Declare ports, internal 4-bit counter, 32-bit output register, and constant/placeholder storage for round sequence values.
structural_blocks.placeholder: // skeleton only: port declarations, rcnt 4-bit register, out 32-bit register, constant placeholders
may_appear: internal constant array or case placeholders

structural_blocks.purpose: Manage rcnt state. Handles synchronous reset/load on kld, normal increment, and overflow continuation beyond 9.
structural_blocks.placeholder: // skeleton only: rcnt update logic on clk edge with kld sync reset and increment conditions

structural_blocks.purpose: Map current rcnt value to the corresponding 32-bit round constant. Implements the GF(2^8) multiplication sequence via lookup/mux.
structural_blocks.placeholder: // skeleton only: rcnt-to-rcon mapping logic with default zero for rcnt > 9

structural_blocks.purpose: Register the mapped round constant onto the out port. Enforces kld synchronous load override to initial constant.
structural_blocks.placeholder: // skeleton only: out register update on clk edge driven by next_rcon_value or kld load value

semantic_modes.meaning: kld asserted, forces rcnt=0 and out=0x01000000
kld deasserted, rcnt advances 0->9, then continues >9
rcnt > 9, out holds 0x00000000 regardless of counter progression

state_model.notes: lower 24 bits always zero, upper 8 bits hold derived GF(2^8) value

global_invariants: out is always registered and updates one time unit after clk rising edge
kld synchronously overrides state and output to initial round constant
out lower 24 bits remain 0x000000 for all valid and overflow states
open_semantic_questions: exact synthesis optimization for lookup vs arithmetic GF(2^8) multiplier (spec provides precomputed values, favoring lookup)

responsibilities: establish all signal widths and reset/load semantics declarations
coupling_rules: provides typed objects for B2, B3, B4
forbidden_drift: do not introduce extra ports, parameters, or implicit reset signals

responsibilities: govern rcnt progression and synchronous reset/load boundary
timing_semantics: updates strictly on clk rising edge
coupling_rules: feeds rcnt to B3; must not directly drive out
forbidden_drift: do not cap counter at 9; spec explicitly requires continued incrementing

responsibilities: translate rcnt index to 32-bit RCON value using spec-derived sequence
timing_semantics: purely combinational; output ready within same cycle as rcnt
coupling_rules: must output 0x00000000 for rcnt > 9; must not depend on kld directly
forbidden_drift: do not compute GF(2^8) multiplication dynamically if precomputed lookup satisfies spec derivation table
do not alter lower 24 bits from zero

responsibilities: register RCON value and enforce kld synchronous load priority
timing_semantics: registered on clk rising edge; one-cycle latency from combinatorial input
coupling_rules: final driver of out port; must respect kld load value over next_rcon_value
forbidden_drift: do not introduce asynchronous reset or enable unless explicitly specified

subtasks.generation_goal: Build port list, internal signal declarations, and constant placeholders aligned with interface and register specs.
subtasks.output_contract: Declares clk, kld, out, rcnt(4), and out(32) with correct widths and directions.
subtasks.merge_contract: Exposes typed identifiers for B2, B3, B4 to reference.

subtasks.generation_goal: Implement synchronous counter logic for rcnt with kld reset and continuous increment rules.
subtasks.output_contract: Produces rcnt next-state logic driven by clk and kld.
subtasks.merge_contract: Provides rcnt value to B3; maintains 4-bit width invariant.

subtasks.generation_goal: Construct combinational mapping from rcnt to 32-bit round constant, including overflow zero case.
subtasks.output_contract: Generates next_rcon_value (32-bit) based on rcnt; lower 24 bits forced to 0.
subtasks.merge_contract: Supplies next_rcon_value to B4; guarantees deterministic combinational output.

subtasks.generation_goal: Implement output registration with kld synchronous load priority and timing compliance.
subtasks.output_contract: Drives out port with registered value; enforces kld=1 -> out=0x01000000.
subtasks.merge_contract: Finalizes module output; matches timing contract for registered change on clk edge.

chosen_decisions.decision: Use precomputed lookup/mux mapping for round constants instead of runtime GF(2^8) multiplier.
chosen_decisions.reason: Spec Section 5.3 explicitly derives and lists all 10 values; lookup reduces complexity and matches "counter-based lookup mechanism" description.

deferred_decisions: exact synthesis pragma or optimization hints for the lookup structure (left to downstream implementation phase)

whether to implement rcnt>9 increment as free-running or clamped (spec says "continues to increment", so free-running is chosen structurally, but exact bit-width behavior beyond 15 is deferred to synthesis constraints)
structural_risks: B3 and B4 separation may introduce unnecessary intermediate signal if synthesis prefers direct registered lookup; will be resolved during merge/debug phase.
Counter overflow handling relies on 4-bit natural wrap; if spec intended exact 10-cycle stop, structural mismatch could occur (mitigated by explicit rcnt>9 combinatorial gate in B3).
behavioral_risks: Timing alignment of kld load vs normal increment must strictly follow "one time unit after clock's rising edge" phrasing; violation could cause off-by-one constant delivery.
Lower 24 bits zeroing constraint must be enforced across all paths; accidental propagation of undefined bits could violate interface contract.
